member: a PARSEX-like member of the jacketed exothermic CSTR family, run for what it makes (cstr/PHYSICS.md, Status)

T_band.why: ours: no tolerance on the reactor temperature was found (cstr/REALITY.md, third search). The top is the size of PARSEX's own excursions, 1.7 and 2 C [S1, Figs. 2, 3]; the bottom is half the shipped 1 K (cstr/PHYSICS.md, section 2; env.py, T_band)

q_min.why: ours: PARSEX's feed range starts at 0 [S1, Table 1] and no turndown was found; the shipped floor is 40 g/s (cstr/PHYSICS.md, section 2; env.py, q_min)

setpoint_ramp.why: derived from one trace: S1's closed loop took about an hour to carry its 2 C move to its peak [S1, Fig. 2]; half and twice that (cstr/PHYSICS.md, section 2; env.py, setpoint_ramp)

coupled_why: none of the three moves with another
no_range_why: the scenario sizes (feed_rise, cooling_loss, k0_decay, event_hold) are ours with ranges written in cstr/PHYSICS.md, but scripts/family_sweep.py applies a drawn number over every scenario's own, which would switch each event on in every scenario; they and the scenario weights were swept by the review's own script on 2026-11-23 (PHYSICS.md, The sweep). No source gives a range for the rest.
